reason: The regulated bank and CA details are reassuring, but I compare to the paisa and $199 on ten lakh is about 1.25% before I even see the exchange rate. I visit India every two years and can do some of this at my own branch, so I would not move money this month.
objection: Which bank actually holds my money, and what is the all-in cost once the partner bank's rate is applied? A flat fee on top of an unknown rate is not something I can compare to Wise, Remitly or my own bank.
would_change_my_mind: A live quote showing the exact rate and total cost in CAD against my bank and Wise, with the named partner bank visible up front, and a fee near $99 for ten lakh.
